threshold_or_content: HR>100, RR>20, SpO2<92% (adults) -> consider uptriage to ESI 2
reported_performance: ESI reliability: weighted kappa 0.70-0.80 (written cases), 0.69-0.87 (real triages); single danger-zone vitals predicted 30-day mortality only weakly in older patients (AUC ~0.56-0.57; combined ~0.64)
kiosk_caveat: 'consider' not 'must'; very common in anxious kiosk users; use as look-closer trigger

source: Tanabe et al. 2003 Acad Emerg Med

threshold_or_content: aggregate 0-3 points per vital band; NEWS2 5-6 moderate, >=7 high risk (sepsis, NG253)
source: Royal College of Physicians NEWS2 (2017); Smith et al. 2013 Resuscitation
reported_performance: AUROC 0.722 cardiac arrest, 0.857 unanticipated ICU, 0.894 death within 24 h (198,755 obs); ED: NEWS AUROC 0.904, NEWS2 0.901; NEWS>=3: sens 74%, spec 96%, PPV 14.5% (ED study)
kiosk_caveat: needs BP, SpO2, consciousness; kiosk has HR, RR, temp only -> partial score

threshold_or_content: NEWS2-based sepsis risk grading for people aged 16+
validated_population: acute hospital, acute mental health setting, ambulance
kiosk_caveat: not a community/kiosk tool; background for fever + fast breathing + confusion

source: Seymour et al. 2016 JAMA; meta-analysis Critical Care 2018
reported_performance: non-ICU AUROC 0.81 for in-hospital death; pooled sensitivity 0.51, specificity 0.83
kiosk_caveat: insensitive; needs BP and infection context

threshold_or_content: chest pain, severe breathlessness, fainting, stroke signs, confusion, worst headache, heavy bleeding, severe allergy, self-harm
source: Manchester Triage System discriminators; NICE CKS red flags; ESI level 1-2 criteria
reported_performance: consensus; triage systems show frequent mistriage (Zachariasse et al. 2019 BMJ Open, doi:10.1136/bmjopen-2018-026471)
kiosk_caveat: depends on user understanding -> wording must be user-tested
